system.description:
You may use your technical expertise to manipulate a Vehicle's systems more quickly than usual.

Prerequisites: Tech Specialist, Trained in Mechanics.

Effect: You may use the Recharge Shields or Reroute Power Actions by spending two Swift Actions. Also, once per encounter, you may attempt to use either of these Actions as a single Swift Action by making a DC 30 Mechanics check.

Normal: The Recharge Shields and Reroute Power Actions normally requires you to spend three Swift Actions.

prerequisite.text: Tech Specialist feat, and Trained in Mechanics
